Little by little, things began to change. Mia's dream job is to be a cook. The experience taught Mia more than any book could. Einstein was as much a theoretician as an experimenter.

Mia bought a T-shirt online because it was much cheaper. On Monday evenings, Mia reviews the notes from class. People around Mia often share different ideas about the kitchen. In fact, he dug the hole with a spade before planting the tree.
At first, Mia found it difficult to keep the habit. Mia wrote down every idea in a small notebook. There is still a long way to go, but the direction is right. He poured gravy over the roast.
What matters most is not speed, but keeping on. They talked about everything from schoolwork to future dreams. Jack and Mia are preparing a report about the kitchen. We had a barbecue on the beach.
Jack always says that small steps matter more than big plans. Sometimes a short talk can solve a big problem. The living room has become an important part of daily life.
